      <title>Accountant</title>
      <description><h4><strong>About Pulsetto</strong></h4><p>Pulsetto is one of the fastest-growing wellness tech companies - in 2025 we were officially recognised by <strong>Deloitte </strong>as the <strong>#1 Company to Watch</strong> in the Technology Fast 50 CE program.</p><p>You may have also seen us on<strong> Netflix’s </strong><em>“Don’t Die”</em>, our founder’s <strong>Shark Tank </strong>pitch 🦈, or even heard that <strong>Cristiano Ronaldo and top NBA players use Pulsetto </strong>for recovery.</p><p>Despite the spotlight, we’re a humble team, moving fast, iterating even faster, and building the future of nervous system wellness. And now we’re expanding our team to power the next stage of global growth.</p><h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4><p>As a <strong>Accountant</strong>, you will take a lead role in the evolution of our financial operations. You aren’t joining just to "maintain" a system; you are joining to <strong>architect</strong> one. Working directly with our Chief accountant, you will be the driving force behind our transition from an outsourced model to a high-performing internal powerhouse.</p><p>This is a role for a process-oriented professional who enjoys the "puzzle" of high-growth accounting. You will take ownership of stabilizing our global e-commerce data flows (Shopify, Amazon) and spearheading our <strong>NetSuite automation</strong>. At Pulsetto, you will have the autonomy to not only manage the books but to influence the digital infrastructure that supports our global brand.</p><h4><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h4><ul><li><p>Entering, reviewing, and recording primary accounting documents in the accounting system.</p></li><li><p>Recording and reconciling expenses incurred using employee corporate cards.</p></li><li><p>Reconciling accounts receivable and accounts payable balances with customers and suppliers.</p></li><li><p>Assisting with month-end closing activities and audit processes.</p></li><li><p>Preparing reports and other documentation as required by the company.</p></li></ul><h4><strong>Requirements</strong></h4><ul><li><p>2+ Years of experience in accounting.</p></li><li><p>System &amp; Data Savvy: Experience with NetSuite or Tier 1 ERPs (like Dynamics 365).</p></li><li><p>LT Compliance: up-to-date knowledge of Lithuanian tax laws.</p></li><li><p>Analytical Ownership: A proactive "builder" mindset. You are comfortable questioning existing processes and taking full responsibility for your area of work.</p></li><li><p>Language: Fluency in English and Lithuanian (written and spoken).</p></li></ul><h4><strong>What We Offer</strong></h4><ul><li><p>Private health insurance after 6 months.</p></li><li><p>Hybrid model — 3 days in the Vilnius office.</p></li><li><p>Work-from-anywhere flexibility: Ability to work from anywhere in the world for up to 40 days per year.</p></li><li><p>Opportunity to directly influence brand trust and organic growth at a global scale.</p></li><li><p>Collaboration with a world-class team across Europe and the US.</p></li><li><p>Office perks — free lunch 3x/week for the Vilnius team.</p></li><li><p>Additional vacation days based on tenure.</p></li><li><p>Birthday day off.</p></li><li><p>Pulsetto device to support your well-being.</p></li><li><p>A fast-growing, supportive environment where experimentation is the norm.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Location: </strong>Vilnius / Hybrid<strong><br>Employment Type: </strong>Full-time<strong><br>Salary:</strong> €2,200–€2,600 gross/month (depending on experience)</p><p><br></p></description>

    <item>
      <title>Senior Accountant</title>
      <description><h4><strong>About Pulsetto</strong></h4><p>Pulsetto is one of the fastest-growing wellness tech companies - in 2025 we were officially recognised by <strong>Deloitte </strong>as the <strong>#1 Company to Watch</strong> in the Technology Fast 50 CE program.</p><p>You may have also seen us on<strong> Netflix’s </strong><em>“Don’t Die”</em>, our founder’s <strong>Shark Tank </strong>pitch 🦈, or even heard that <strong>Cristiano Ronaldo and top NBA players use Pulsetto </strong>for recovery.</p><p>Despite the spotlight, we’re a humble team, moving fast, iterating even faster, and building the future of nervous system wellness. And now we’re expanding our team to power the next stage of global growth.</p><h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4><p>As a <strong>Senior Accountant</strong>, you will take a lead role in the evolution of our financial operations. You aren’t joining just to "maintain" a system; you are joining to <strong>architect</strong> one. Working directly with our Chief accountant, you will be the driving force behind our transition from an outsourced model to a high-performing internal powerhouse.</p><p>This is a role for a process-oriented professional who enjoys the "puzzle" of high-growth accounting. You will take ownership of stabilizing our global e-commerce data flows (Shopify, Amazon) and spearheading our <strong>NetSuite automation</strong>. At Pulsetto, you will have the autonomy to not only manage the books but to influence the digital infrastructure that supports our global brand.</p><h4><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h4><ul><li><p>Work alongside the Chief Accountant to move tasks from the external service provider in-house.</p></li><li><p>Maintain full-cycle bookkeeping and reconciliations: sales, expenses, prepayments and accruals, bank transactions, AR, AP, FX transactions, etc. across all global entities. Identify gaps in the data flow and suggest structural fixes.</p></li><li><p>Manage the current manual sales records (Shopify, Amazon, etc.) into Netsuite with the goal of full automation.</p></li><li><p>Prepare and manage monthly VAT, i.SAF, and local LT tax declarations (PIT, SODRA).</p></li><li><p>Support Chief accountant in delivering timely and accurate month-end closing tasks and internal reporting.</p></li><li><p>Support Chief accountant in preparation of financial statements and annual statutory audit.</p></li><li><p>Once automated, help the Chief accountant to design and maintain control procedures to ensure data integrity.</p></li></ul><h4><strong>Requirements</strong></h4><ul><li><p>3+ Years of full-Cycle Accounting: Deep understanding of the entire accounting lifecycle, from initial transaction flows to more complex transactions and month-end procedures.</p></li><li><p>Versatile Experience: broad track record across multiple accounting functions, not soiled in one area (e.g., just AP or just Payroll).</p></li><li><p>System &amp; Data Savvy: Experience with NetSuite or Tier 1 ERPs (like Dynamics 365).</p></li><li><p>LT Compliance: up-to-date knowledge of Lithuanian tax laws (VAT/i.SAF, PIT, SODRA).</p></li><li><p>Analytical Ownership: A proactive "builder" mindset. You are comfortable questioning existing processes and taking full responsibility for your area of work.</p></li><li><p>Language: Fluency in English and Lithuanian (written and spoken).</p></li></ul><h4><strong>What We Offer</strong></h4><ul><li><p>Private health insurance after 6 months.</p></li><li><p>Hybrid model — 3 days in the Vilnius office.</p></li><li><p>Work-from-anywhere flexibility: Ability to work from anywhere in the world for up to 40 days per year.</p></li><li><p>Opportunity to directly influence brand trust and organic growth at a global scale.</p></li><li><p>Collaboration with a world-class team across Europe and the US.</p></li><li><p>Office perks — free lunch 3x/week for the Vilnius team.</p></li><li><p>Additional vacation days based on tenure.</p></li><li><p>Birthday day off.</p></li><li><p>Pulsetto device to support your well-being.</p></li><li><p>A fast-growing, supportive environment where experimentation is the norm.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Location: </strong>Vilnius / Hybrid<strong><br>Employment Type: </strong>Full-time<strong><br>Salary:</strong> €2,800–€4,000 gross/month (depending on experience)</p><p><br></p></description>

    <item>
      <title>Head of Data Department</title>
      <description><h4><strong>About Pulsetto</strong></h4><p>Pulsetto is one of the fastest-growing wellness tech companies - in 2025 we were&nbsp;officially recognised by <strong>Deloitte </strong>as the <strong>#1 Company to Watch</strong> in the Technology Fast 50 CE program.<br></p><p>You may have also seen us on<strong> Netflix’s <em>“Don’t Die”</em></strong>, our founder’s <strong>Shark Tank </strong>pitch 🦈, or even heard that <strong>Cristiano Ronaldo and top NBA players use Pulsetto </strong>for recovery.&nbsp;</p><p>Despite the spotlight, we’re a humble team, moving fast,&nbsp;iterating even faster, and building the future of nervous system wellness. And now we’re expanding our team to power the next stage of global growth.</p><h4><strong>About the Role &amp; Company Context</strong></h4><p>Pulsetto is a fast-growing, DTC wellness-tech company selling the hardware and operating across e-commerce, a subscription model, and a companion app. As operational complexity increases, we're looking for a Head of Data to become the analytical backbone of the company, enabling faster and more confident decisions across departments.</p><p>This is a hybrid role leading a small, agile data team (1–3 people) — a setup where the Head of Data stays close to the data day-to-day (roughly 50% hands-on) while also directing the team's priorities and growth. You'll work across a wide range of stakeholders — marketing, product, finance, and operations — each with different, sometimes competing, data needs, and you'll be the one who decides what gets prioritized and why.</p><h4><strong>Core Responsibilities</strong></h4><p><strong><em>Data ownership &amp; architecture</em></strong></p><ul><li><p>Own end-to-end data architecture and infrastructure strategy for the company</p></li><li><p>Lead ingestion, integration and preparation of data from all company sources (e-commerce, marketing/ads platforms, CRM, app/product, finance, ops)</p></li><li><p>Establish and monitor data quality standards and governance across systems</p></li><li><p>Build and maintain company-wide reporting and dashboards (executive + departmental)</p></li><li><p>Ensure data integrity and a single source of truth across systems</p></li><li><p>Convert raw data into actionable insights across marketing, sales, product, finance and operations</p></li><li><p>Own the product analytics agenda — define product metrics, run A/B testing, and embed data into the product development cycle</p></li></ul><p><strong><em>Team leadership &amp; stakeholder management</em></strong></p><ul><li><p>Lead, mentor and grow a small data team — setting clear priorities, supporting career development, and ensuring fast, high-quality delivery</p></li><li><p>Act as the main point of contact for data needs across marketing, product, finance and operations, balancing and prioritizing competing requests</p></li><li><p>Bring structure and prioritization discipline to a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment</p></li></ul><h4><strong>Must-Have Requirements</strong></h4><ul><li><p>5+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or BI, including proven ownership of a data function or team</p></li><li><p>Hands-on experience designing data architecture and pipelines (ETL/ELT) across multiple, disparate sources; experience with dbt</p></li><li><p>Strong SQL and experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar)</p></li><li><p>Experience with BI/visualization tools (LightDash, Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar)</p></li><li><p>Experience with e-commerce and marketing data (Shopify, Meta/Google Ads, GA4, CRM)</p></li><li><p>Product analytics experience — defining product metrics, running A/B tests, and understanding the role of data in the product development cycle</p></li><li><p>Strong communication and prioritization skills — able to navigate and balance the needs of multiple stakeholders across marketing, product, finance and operations</p></li><li><p>Fluent English</p></li></ul><p><strong>Nice-to-Have</strong></p><ul><li><p>People leadership experience (hiring, mentoring, managing a small team)</p></li><li><p>Experience in DTC/e-commerce, subscription, or health &amp; wellness/consumer tech</p></li><li><p>Python or similar for data processing/automation</p></li><li><p>Experience scaling a data function in a startup/scale-up</p></li></ul><h4><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-eee32483-7fff-eac4-1eab-a5a2d32f6809">What We Offer</strong></span></h4><ul><li><p><span>Private health insurance after 6 months.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Hybrid model — 3 days in the Vilnius office.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Work-from-anywhere flexibility: Ability to work from anywhere in the world for up to 40 days per year.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Opportunity to directly influence brand trust and organic growth at a global scale.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Collaboration with a world-class team across Europe and the US.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Office perks — free lunch 3x/week for the Vilnius team.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Additional vacation days based on tenure.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Birthday day off.</span></p></li><li><p><span>Pulsetto device to support your well-being.</span></p></li><li><p><span>A fast-growing, supportive environment where experimentation is the norm.</span></p></li></ul><p><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-eee32483-7fff-eac4-1eab-a5a2d32f6809">Location: </strong>Vilnius / Hybrid <strong id="docs-internal-guid-eee32483-7fff-eac4-1eab-a5a2d32f6809"><br>Employment Type: </strong>Full-time<strong id="docs-internal-guid-eee32483-7fff-eac4-1eab-a5a2d32f6809"><br>Salary: </strong></span><strong>€5,000–8,000 gross/month</strong></p></description>

    <item>
      <title>Pulsetto Talent Pool</title>
      <description><h3>Why Join Our Talent Pool?</h3><p>Even if there’s no open role that fits your profile today, Pulsetto is growing rapidly — and we love connecting with <strong>proactive, curious, and impact-driven people</strong> who want to shape the future of wellness tech.</p><p>By joining our talent pool, you’ll:</p><ul>
<li>Be considered and contacted when a <strong>position matching your experience and skills</strong> opens up</li>
<li>Get a chance to join a <strong>mission-driven, international team</strong> where ownership and creativity are valued</li>
<li>Potentially help us <strong>shape entirely new roles</strong> that don’t exist yet but should</li>
</ul><h3>Who We’re Looking For</h3><p>We’re interested in people who are:</p><ul>
<li>Curious, ambitious, and eager to build meaningful products</li>
<li>Strong communicators who thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments</li>
<li>Skilled in their craft — whether that’s marketing, RnD, operations, HR or something unexpected that we didn’t know we needed yet</li>
</ul><h3>What We Offer</h3><ul>
<li>Hybrid work model – 3 days in the office (Vilnius) or fully remote if based elsewhere</li>
<li>Office perks for our Vilnius team – including free lunch 3 times a week</li>
<li>Birthday day off – celebrate on your terms</li>
<li>Additional days off per year - 2 on your first year, 3 on your second, 4 from the 3rd year</li>
<li>Get your own Pulsetto device and premium app – support your well-being daily</li>
<li>An open, supportive environment where dreaming big is part of the job</li>
</ul><p>📍 <strong>Location:</strong> Vilnius / Hybrid / Remote<br>🕐 <strong>Employment Type:</strong> Full-time / Future opportunities</p><p>👉 <strong>Interested?</strong> Apply here to join our talent pool, and we’ll get in touch if a role opens up that matches your profile.</p></description>
